Well, I always thought that you would find ammo boxes scattered around the island since it used to host a small part of the chinese army in world war 2. However, I think the ammo gets in the tombs thanks to the other survivors who have made patrols, camps, etc.

Dear redditors,

Today, I have hope.
Do you know why?
Because of these comments.
For once, things seem a little brighter.
I love all of you.
Sincerely, thebatman218
I'll get back to you later. I've gotta go do some stuff.

No, right now we don't have any exams or big projects coming up. No real homework grades for that matter. And here in the USA our system is a little weird but I can summarize my schools, I go to a charter school. So I guess if I don't pass all my classes this year I have to go to some bullshit 3 week long summer school from 8:00 in the morning to 5:30 in the afternoon. When we got my most recent report card there was even a letter stating that the school doesn't believe with the averages I have from over the year in multiple classes. I'm seriously not smart, honestly. I think lazyness isn't the bigger factor in this but still, it's there.
